answer: A coastal forge buys one indivisible delivery of juniper charcoal before high tide. The lowest binding sealed bid wins and is paid its own price after verified delivery. Break ties by earliest commitment, and allow repeated bids under the same key. Any seller's alias bids can then be replaced by its earliest lowest bid without changing the auction result. More names neither improve its price nor grant extra entries. This limits false-name bidding, not flooding, nonperformance or collusion; it relies on honest timing and delivery checks.
